mapper.select:
select from qms_insp h join lot_master l on l.lot_id = h.lot_id where h.insp_type in ('FIRST_OFF', 'LAST_OFF') and h.status <> 'VOID'
and h.proc_id = #{procId} and h.proc_id is null
and h.lot_id in #{x} order by h.occurred_at desc, h.insp_id desc

select from qms_insp h join lot_master l on l.lot_id = h.lot_id where h.insp_type = #{inspType} and h.proc_id = #{procId} and h.status <> 'VOID' and h.lot_id in #{x} order by h.occurred_at desc, h.insp_id desc
select insp_id, insp_no, status, occurred_at from qms_insp where insp_no = #{no}
select asset_id from mst_phys_asset where asset_type = 'GAUGE' and asset_cd = #{cd}
select count(*) from qms_insp_meas m where m.void_of_id is null and not exists (select 1 from qms_insp_meas v where v.void_of_id = m.meas_id)
select insp_id, status, row_ver from qms_insp where insp_id = #{id} for update

select x.insp_line_id, x.line_no, x.char_id, coalesce(i.item_cd, p.proc_cd) || '-' || c.char_no as char_label, c.char_nm, x.data_type, x.nominal, x.lsl, x.usl, x.scale, x.unit_nm, x.gauge_class, x.sample_size, x.ac, x.re, x.result from qms_insp_line x join qms_char c on c.char_id = x.char_id left join mst_item i on i.item_id = c.item_id left join mst_proc p on p.proc_id = c.proc_id where x.insp_id = #{id} order by x.line_no

select m.meas_id, m.insp_line_id, m.sample_no, m.value, m.ok_yn, m.gauge_asset_id, a.asset_cd as gauge_cd, m.occurred_at, m.recorded_by, m.entry_method from qms_insp_meas m join qms_insp_line x on x.insp_line_id = m.insp_line_id left join mst_phys_asset a on a.asset_id = m.gauge_asset_id where x.insp_id = #{id} and m.void_of_id is null and not exists (select 1 from qms_insp_meas v where v.void_of_id = m.meas_id) order by m.insp_line_id, m.sample_no
select proc_id from mst_proc where proc_cd = #{cd}

select l.line_id, l.line_no, l.char_id, coalesce(l.data_type, c.data_type) as data_type, coalesce(l.nominal, c.nominal) as nominal, coalesce(l.lsl, c.lsl) as lsl, coalesce(l.usl, c.usl) as usl, coalesce(l.scale, c.scale) as scale, coalesce(l.unit_nm, c.unit_nm) as unit_nm, l.gauge_class, l.sampling_plan_id from qms_insp_plan_line l join qms_char c on c.char_id = l.char_id where l.insp_plan_id = #{planId} order by l.line_no

insert into qms_insp (comp_cd, insp_no, insp_type, lot_id, item_id, proc_id, insp_plan_id, lot_qty, occurred_at, remark, created_by, updated_by, open_worker_id, open_terminal_id, open_req_id) values (hb_current_comp(), #{no}, #{type}, #{lotId}, #{itemId}, #{procId}, #{planId}, #{lotQty}, #{at}, #{remark}, #{by}, #{by}, #{floor.workerId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{floor.terminalId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{floor.clientReqId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) returning insp_id

(hb_current_comp(), #{r.inspLineId}, #{r.sampleNo}, #{r.value}, #{r.okYn}, #{r.gaugeAssetId}, #{r.occurredAt}, #{by}, #{src.entryMethod}, #{src.importJobId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{src.workerId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{src.terminalId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{src.clientReqId,jdbcType=VARCHAR})

insert into qms_insp_meas (comp_cd, insp_line_id, sample_no, void_of_id, occurred_at, recorded_by) select hb_current_comp(), m.insp_line_id, m.sample_no, m.meas_id, #{at}, #{by} from qms_insp_meas m join qms_insp_line x on x.insp_line_id = m.insp_line_id where m.meas_id = #{measId} and x.insp_id = #{inspId} and m.void_of_id is null and not exists (select 1 from qms_insp_meas v where v.void_of_id = m.meas_id)
